newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on weak sentiment.

text.p: Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) shares are expected to continue their bear-run for a fourth straight day on Tuesday on mostly retail selling, brokers said.
"The retail investors may continue their selling as they seek cash for new initial public offerings (IPOs)," said broker Shakil Rizvi.
Brokers, however, said the rate of decline may slow as blue chips that lost in the past several sessions might lure some buyers.
The DSE all-share price index fell 30.16 points or 2.8 percent to 1,044.08 on turnover of 43.8 million taka on Monday. -- Dhaka newsroom +880-2-506363
